messages.note_link: To copy the link of the file you're on in File Explorer, say "copy link" to Aruna, or give "Copy the Dropbox link of the file selected in File Explorer" a key in Input Gestures and make it global. "copy link to" followed by a name finds a file by name, and "Dropbox status" says whether everything has synced.
messages.note_privacy: Hariku asks Dropbox only about names, sizes and times of your files and for links; it never reads or uploads their contents. Your sign-in is kept encrypted on this computer.
